investigation_notes.User Lookup Result: No users found for email: acc@globalcorp.ee
investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous volume of SharePoint downloads (305 files vs 28 baseline) was observed from acc@globalcorp.ee targeting the Finland HR Mepco sync site. The activity used the Mepco MSGraph application and a WinHttpRequest user-agent, and occurred at 15:10 local time in Tampere, which aligns with business hours. The site URL and application name are consistent with an automated integration/sync account handling HR/financial files, and there are no recent related events or similar alerts to suggest broader malicious activity. Given the integration-like context, business-hour timing, and lack of corroborating suspicious signals, the activity is considered Low Priority.
